data.name: Henry
data.gender_notes: Henry is used as a male name in christian naming traditions.
data.short_meaning: Home ruler; ruler of the enclosure
data.long_meaning: From the Germanic heim, 'home', + ric, 'ruler'. Its root is Germanic heim + ric. A common Christian name; borne by several kings and saints. Henry is a Germanic name meaning “Home ruler; ruler of the enclosure”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Henry expresses “Home ruler; ruler of the enclosure”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Henry total 34, reducing to 7. Number 7 is associated with reflection, analysis and inner search.
